words_to_learn.en: young girl (малој as dialect vocative form)

lines.en: - Angelina, young girl,
come on, Angelina, young girl,
come on, are you selling your black eyes?
- Hey you fool, you novice,
come on, hey you fool, you novice,

lines.cyr: ајде не се цреши да ги купиш.
lines.lat: ajde ne se creši da gi kupiš.
lines.en: come on, they are not cherries for you to buy.
- Angelina, young girl,
come on, Angelina, young girl,
come on, are you selling your white face?
- Hey you fool, you novice,
come on, hey you fool, you novice,

lines.cyr: ајде не е симит да го јадеш.
lines.lat: ajde ne e simit da go jadeš.
lines.en: come on, it is not a simit for you to eat.
- Angelina, young girl,
come on, Angelina, young girl,
come on, are you selling your slender figure?
- Hey you fool, you novice,
come on, hey you fool, you novice,

lines.cyr: не е вита ела да ја сечеш.
lines.lat: ne e vita ela da ja sečeš.
lines.en: it is not a slim fir tree for you to cut.
- Angelina, young girl,
come on, Angelina, young girl,

lines.cyr: дали вечер стројник да ти пратам?
lines.lat: dali večer strojnik da ti pratam?
lines.en: shall I send a matchmaker to you tonight?
- Hey you fool, you novice,
come on, hey you fool, you novice,

lines.cyr: ајде и да пратиш, фајде немаш.
lines.lat: ajde i da pratiš, fajde nemaš.
lines.en: come on, even if you send one, you have no use.
Hey, I am, my dear, engaged,

lines.cyr: ајде во недела свадба ќе ми прават.
lines.lat: ajde vo nedela svadba ḱe mi pravat.
lines.en: come on, on Sunday they will hold my wedding.
